blocks.title: Custom X For You feed
blocks.extended: A Chrome extension that overrides X’s “For You” feed using user-defined intent. This idea came from the fact that on X, I primarily want to see AI news, but I'm seeing other information that I'm not interested in seeing. This project will be my main focus for the coming weeks.

featuredProjects.title: SuperflowAI
featuredProjects.tagline: Free Open Source Windows voice dictation with instant auto paste
featuredProjects.summary: Super Flow is a free, open source Windows voice dictation app for fast, seamless typing. Hold Ctrl + Alt + Space to record, release to transcribe and auto paste at the cursor. It includes mic selection, toggle or hold modes, multiple recorder views, session transcripts with copy and PDF export, and automatic updates via GitHub.

featuredProjects.title: PolyOpus
featuredProjects.summary: Open experiment testing whether Claude can compound $200 to $2,000 through live sports prediction market trades. Every cycle is transparent: research, reasoning, execution, and live PnL are published on the public dashboard.

featuredProjects.title: DeepConverge
featuredProjects.summary: Full-stack multi-agent debate platform with Advocate, Critic, and Judge agents streaming real-time reasoning. Includes waitlist access, debate history replay, PDF export, and a convergent thinking mode.
